input: Research international pen pal programs for my teenager

gold.taskTitle: Research International Pen Pal Programs for Teenager
gold.taskDescription: Find suitable international pen pal programs that match the teenager's interests, age, and safety requirements.

questions.title: How old is your teenager specifically?
questions.description: Knowing the exact age helps identify programs designed for the right peer group.

questions.title: Is this for digital pen pals or physical letters?
questions.description: Understanding the preferred format narrows down which platforms or programs to focus on.

questions.title: Which countries or regions should the pen pal be from?
questions.description: A target region or language helps filter programs by geographic focus.

questions.title: What is the primary goal — language practice or cultural exchange?
questions.description: The purpose shapes which program type and structure will be most effective.

questions.title: Does the program need to be school-affiliated or independent?
questions.description: Some families prefer institutionally supervised programs while others want independent ones.

questions.title: What is your budget for any membership or subscription fees?
questions.description: Some pen pal services are free while others charge fees for access or moderation.

questions.title: How important is adult moderation and safety oversight to you?
questions.description: Safety requirements will determine which platforms are appropriate to recommend.
